ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY (ZONING) REGULATION, 1992
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY
(ZONING) REGULATION, 1992
(Addition of Cl. (aa) in para. 4 of Chap. III)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 3rd July, 2007]
S.R.O. 670(I)/2007, dated 28-6-2007.--In exercise of
the powers conferred by section 51 of the Capital Development Authority
Ordinance, 1960 (No.XXIII of 1960), read with section II thereof, the Capital
Development Authority has been pleased to make the following amendment in the
Islamabad Capital Territory (Zoning) Regulation, 1992, namely:--
In the said Regulation, in Chapter III, in paragraph
4, under the heading Zone-4 under subheading "Unacquired Area", in
sub-paragraph (B), after clause (a), the following new clause shall be
inserted, namely: --
(aa) subject to grant of NOC by the Authority,
construction on unutilized patches of land within built up area and astride
major roads of the ICT i.e. Islamabad Highway, Murree Road, Bara Kahu, Simly
Road, Park Road, Kuri Road and Lehtrar Road shall be permissible on case to
case basis according to healthy planning parameters and CDA building bye-laws.
The layout, design and development specifications shall be subject to the
approval of the Authority and a completion certificate in respect thereof shall
have to be obtained from CDA."
